From Atom Heart Father · Price: you need a photo or drawing of the target.

Theme Space

  • 1: 10 minutes: make a picture of a creature. While you hold it, you know the direction to that creature within 1 mile. In combat, your stand can instead snap a quick picture of a creature it can see within 30 ft as part of any Photo Prison action; a quick picture fades after 1 minute. 1 action: snap a quick picture and pin the creature to that instant (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates): on a failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the end of your next turn, and on a critical failure it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} until the end of your next turn. Or 1 action: tear a corner of a quick picture: its creature takes @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] damage (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}) and, on a failure or critical failure, is pinned as above.
  • 5: Surge, 2 actions: tear part of the picture; the creature takes @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}), once per day per picture.
  • 9: Surge: trap a creature in its picture (@Check[will|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Will}, incapacitation): on a failure it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round, on a critical failure for 1 minute.
  • 13: Picture range 5 miles. You can trap a picture of up to two creatures at once. Your surge tear takes 1 action, and tearing a corner affects up to two creatures in the same picture.
  • 17: You can trap a whole picture of up to four creatures at once.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
